records.name: Otto Coilshell
records.biography_en: The occupant answered the door from inside Otto's head. He asked me to leave it a note anyway.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The occupant answered the door from inside Otto's head. He asked me to leave it a note anyway.

records.name: Faye Siftspore
records.biography_en: She filtered out three spores and a rumor. The rumor had passed through twice.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: She filtered out three spores and a rumor. The rumor had passed through twice.

records.name: Hugo Hatchclick
records.biography_en: The antennae emerged before the creature. He called that an early signal.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The antennae emerged before the creature. He called that an early signal.

records.name: Nell Mosslift
records.biography_en: The fungus had reached its destination. Nell was still on the way to hers.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The fungus had reached its destination. Nell was still on the way to hers.

records.name: Bo Bubbleside
records.biography_en: He held his breath until the air sac made the decision for him.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He held his breath until the air sac made the decision for him.

records.name: Cal Saltlick
records.biography_en: Cal assured me it was only a sample. The sample was visibly smaller when he said it.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: Cal assured me it was only a sample. The sample was visibly smaller when he said it.
